CustomField.description: When ticked, a Webshop order gets the order confirmation email automatically when it goes to Closed Won (by hand, by the Process Order button or by Auto-Process Orders). When not ticked, no confirmation is sent automatically; the Resend Confirmation button still sends one.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When ticked, a Webshop order gets the order confirmation email automatically when it goes to Closed Won (by hand, by the Process Order button or by Auto-Process Orders). When not ticked, no confirmation is sent automatically; the Resend Confirmation button still sends one.
CustomField.label: Send Order Confirmation (Dealer Portal)
